extracted.intended_audience: prospective students and performers seeking improv and sketch comedy training (all ages and levels)
extracted.subtask_description: Information and standards for enrolling in and participating in The Second City Training Center's improv and sketch comedy classes in Chicago, including course offerings, performance opportunities, and student support. Aimed at hobbyists through aspiring professionals across ages and experience levels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow Second City traditions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Training Center follows the traditions developed by these groundbreaking and innovative men and women.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes learning within the lineage and methods historically associated with The Second City while building on that foundation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encourage growth and development of the art forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Encouraging the continued growth and development of the art forms of comedy and improvisation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Courses are intended not just to teach techniques but to foster ongoing artistic development and innovation in improv and sketch.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessibility for all levels and ages
rubrics_metrics.description: We offer a variety of classes in the performance arts for students at any level of experience. Whether a seasoned performer or someone who's never been onstage, you are encouraged to take classes with us.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Course catalog and registration are designed to accommodate beginners through experienced performers, including youth programs (e.g., Spring Break Intensives ages 8-18).

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for individual student goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Our students come from a diverse array of backgrounds, each with a unique accomplishment they wish to achieve with our courses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Training Center positions itself to help students meet varied personal objectives—career development, skill-building, or recreational goals—and invites contact for questions or concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Focus on skill growth and supportive environment
rubrics_metrics.description: Whatever your reasons for taking classes with us, we are here to support you and help you grow your skills.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Instructors and staff provide student support aimed at measurable improvement in performance skills and confidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specialized skill offerings
rubrics_metrics.description: Course examples include 'Dynamic Falls and Slams', 'Songwriting for Comedic Characters', and age‑specific intensives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curriculum includes targeted workshops and courses teaching physical comedy, comedic songwriting, and other specialty techniques—allowing students to develop niche competencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: End-of-term class performances
rubrics_metrics.description: Class Performances: See our schedule of end-of-term class performances by our students.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Performance opportunities are built into the program to give students practical, public-facing experience and to showcase progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Faculty quality and recognition
rubrics_metrics.description: The site spotlights instructors (e.g., 'Teacher of the Week') and lists featured faculty such as Aaron Graham (Music Improv).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights suggest selection of instructors with relevant performance/teaching credentials and opportunities for students to learn from experienced professionals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community engagement and publicity
rubrics_metrics.description: The Second City Training Center shines the Spotlight on students, student-performers, teachers, and training center faculty in The Second City Spotlight—interviews, podcasts, blogs and more about the TC experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs include channels for community recognition and media exposure which can be part of a student's development and networking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative and scheduling requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: See all the important dates for the entire calendar year; the next term is just around the corner! Browse our course catalog, or register now!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participation requires timely registration and adherence to term calendars; prospective students should consult the course catalog and academic calendar when planning attendance.
